[Merged] Fix another potential buffer overread in the zipfile extension.

FossilOrigin-Name: 0819fe670f9ceec79f84eb09c234dc29f6581332f86a53d6a0547697404efff1
pr_description: Check that each in-memory ZIP central-directory entry contains its complete filename and extra data before reading them. Compute the boundary using the 46-byte central-directory header and report corruption when the payload exceeds the blob.

intro_commit_message:
Fix another potential buffer overread in the zipfile extension.

FossilOrigin-Name: 0819fe670f9ceec79f84eb09c234dc29f6581332f86a53d6a0547697404efff1
fix_commit_message:
Fix a typo in [0819fe670f9ceec7] that lead to incomplete protection against buffer overflow in the zipfile extension. [forum:/forumpost/2025-12-30T23:57:19z|Forum post 2025-12-30T23:57:19z]

FossilOrigin-Name: a6abbadacbb88c1ddcc236b40fb34eddf3bb0891189bd00a5af8d34b42871967
agent_reasoning: The bounds check used the 30-byte local-file header size even though the data pointer advances past the 46-byte central-directory header. This understated the required buffer length by 16 bytes and could allow out-of-bounds reads. The source now uses ZIPFILE_CDS_FIXED_SZ in the guard, matching the data pointer offset and rejecting truncated payloads before subsequent reads. Only the one-line source correction was applied; test files and Fossil metadata were not edited. Workspace validation passed against intro_parent.
